name: w-temple

name: film2-dolly
setup: bend.set('temple', { tideHold: 0.12 }); bend.set('camera', { followFov: 34, followSwing: 0 }); bend.wake(); bend.place(0,-0.9,0.3,Math.PI/2); bend.place(1,0.9,0.3,-Math.PI/2);
each: bend.set('camera', { followDist: 8 - t*0.6, followPitch: 0.04 + t*0.01 }); bend.camera({ yaw: 0.1 + t*0.05 });

name: tm-lead
setup: bend.set('temple', { tideHold: 0.12 }); bend.set('camera', { followFov: 34, followSwing: 0, followDist: 4.2, followPitch: 0.03 }); bend.wake(); bend.place(0,-1.2,0.3,Math.PI/2); bend.place(1,1.2,0.3,-Math.PI/2);

cues.0.2: const L=(bend.rig.plane?.ledges??[]).filter(l=>!l.bob).slice().sort((a,b)=>a.x0-b.x0); const cs=bend.show.dancers.map(d=>d.controller).filter(c=>c.kind==='intent'); if(L.length){ const a=L[0], b=L[L.length-1]; cs[0].character.reset((a.x0+a.x1)/2, a.y+0.15); cs[1].character.reset((b.x0+b.x1)/2, b.y+0.15);} console.warn('ledges temple', JSON.stringify(L));

name: t-redwoods-jogo
